environment.process_note: Build and test environment only. No credentials, tokens, private messages, contacts, provider payloads, or secret canary values were included in evidence.

parity_summary.storage: Protected metadata is separate from FLPSV001 encrypted secret records. The OS keyring stores only the wrapping key; records use opaque namespaced references, hashed filenames, random nonces, reference AAD, atomic writes, private directories, and zeroizing reads.
parity_summary.credential_classes: The boundary covers Twilio, Telnyx SMS, email, push, MCP, agent-channel, local-integration, and linked-node lifecycle credentials. Telnyx Fax metadata/env support remains separate from the TPR-003 renderer scope.
parity_summary.runtime_boundary: Tauri clears inherited environment variables, restores a small OS/runtime allow-list, injects only required protected values into the child backend, suppresses child stdout/stderr, and exposes only bounded errors and redacted status/debug shapes.
parity_summary.renderer_boundary: The shared shell bridge returns presence flags and redacted metadata only. Secret entry fields clear after save; synthetic canary assertions found no secret values in rendered document text.
parity_summary.external_compatibility: MCP, agent-channel, and local-integration consumers may receive atomic 0600 plaintext compatibility token files on desktop. The encrypted vault is the source of truth; these files are not created on mobile and their contents are never returned through the renderer bridge.
parity_summary.migration: Electron safeStorage blobs are not automatically decrypted. Legacy candidate files are detected and preserved, and the Settings surface requires manual re-entry. This is an explicit no-silent-loss strategy, not an automatic conversion claim.
parity_summary.mobile: Desktop protected storage and secret material are excluded from Android/iOS cfg paths; mobile remains metadata-only/remote-only with no private database replication.
